passage.title: Reading Part 1 - Test 09
passage.text:
Employee Wellness Program - Updated Guidelines

We are pleased to announce enhanced benefits for our Employee Wellness Program, effective June 1st. The program aims to promote a healthy work-life balance and support our employees' overall well-being.

Fitness Membership: All full-time employees are eligible for a complimentary gym membership at partner facilities. This benefit is optional and can be activated through the HR portal. Part-time employees receive a 50% discount on membership fees.

Mental Health Support: We now offer confidential counseling services through our Employee Assistance Program. Sessions are completely voluntary and won't affect your employment status. Up to 10 sessions per year are covered at no cost to employees.

Healthy Lifestyle Incentives: Employees who participate in quarterly wellness challenges can earn rewards such as extra vacation days or gift cards. Participation is encouraged but not required. We believe that a healthy team is a productive and happy team!
